outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: (1) Minor paraphrasing of the work-site arrangement (“hybrid 3-days/week in-office” vs. the page text “3 days / week in-office”) is not material. (2) Not explicitly re-stating the listing’s location from an on-page location field is a minor issue if the listing is clearly within the Redmond-filtered search context, though it does reduce certainty.

Critical issues: The agent did not provide two key responsibilities and did not provide two preferred qualifications. This is not a minor formatting problem; it is a failure to deliver half of the explicitly requested fields and the main “extraction” part of the task. 

What was completed: The action history shows the agent searched Microsoft Careers for “Applied Scientist” with location set to “Redmond, Washington,” clicked “Find jobs,” opened a specific Applied Scientist listing (“Applied Scientist II / Senior Applied Scientist - Responsible AI (CoreAI)”). Screenshot/DOM evidence (DOM state index 4) supports that this listing contains and shows (at least in one captured state) the job number “200017828” and the work-site arrangement “Work site 3 days / week in-office,” matching the agent’s reported job number and arrangement.

What was not completed / why it matters: The agent claims it could not access the detailed job description content (responsibilities and preferred qualifications). Regardless of whether this was due to a tooling/DOM capture limitation, the user’s requested end result is the extracted responsibilities and preferred qualifications, and the agent did not provide them or provide an acceptable substitute (e.g., explicitly stating that the listing does not list preferred qualifications/responsibilities). The screenshots provided also do not confirm an unavoidable external blocker like a login wall/CAPTCHA preventing access; they mainly show missing/empty DOM snapshots in later states. From an average user perspective, the outcome is that they still don’t have the responsibilities and preferred qualifications they asked for.

Constraints compliance: The agent appears to have respected constraints (no sign-in, no apply, no form submission) and stopped without initiating an application. That is good, but it doesn’t compensate for the missing required extracted content.

Overall, because the agent failed to report two responsibilities and two preferred qualifications, the primary intent was not achieved.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to use Microsoft Careers to find and open a relevant “Applied Scientist” job listing in Redmond, Washington, then extract and report four concrete items from that listing: the job number, the work-site arrangement, two key responsibilities, and two preferred qualifications. A reasonable user would be flexible about which specific Applied Scientist listing is chosen as long as it’s relevant and in/for Redmond (or clearly the closest available), but would not be flexible about missing the requested extracted details—especially the responsibilities and preferred qualifications, which are core deliverables.

step8_outcome_verification.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to use Microsoft Careers to find and open a relevant “Applied Scientist” job listing in Redmond, Washington, then extract and report four concrete items from that listing: the job number, the work-site arrangement, two key responsibilities, and two preferred qualifications. A reasonable user would be flexible about which specific Applied Scientist listing is chosen as long as it’s relevant and in/for Redmond (or clearly the closest available), but would not be flexible about missing the requested extracted details—especially the responsibilities and preferred qualifications, which are core deliverables.
step8_outcome_verification.reasoning:
Nitpicks: (1) Minor paraphrasing of the work-site arrangement (“hybrid 3-days/week in-office” vs. the page text “3 days / week in-office”) is not material. (2) Not explicitly re-stating the listing’s location from an on-page location field is a minor issue if the listing is clearly within the Redmond-filtered search context, though it does reduce certainty.

Critical issues: The agent did not provide two key responsibilities and did not provide two preferred qualifications. This is not a minor formatting problem; it is a failure to deliver half of the explicitly requested fields and the main “extraction” part of the task. 

What was completed: The action history shows the agent searched Microsoft Careers for “Applied Scientist” with location set to “Redmond, Washington,” clicked “Find jobs,” opened a specific Applied Scientist listing (“Applied Scientist II / Senior Applied Scientist - Responsible AI (CoreAI)”). Screenshot/DOM evidence (DOM state index 4) supports that this listing contains and shows (at least in one captured state) the job number “200017828” and the work-site arrangement “Work site 3 days / week in-office,” matching the agent’s reported job number and arrangement.

What was not completed / why it matters: The agent claims it could not access the detailed job description content (responsibilities and preferred qualifications). Regardless of whether this was due to a tooling/DOM capture limitation, the user’s requested end result is the extracted responsibilities and preferred qualifications, and the agent did not provide them or provide an acceptable substitute (e.g., explicitly stating that the listing does not list preferred qualifications/responsibilities). The screenshots provided also do not confirm an unavoidable external blocker like a login wall/CAPTCHA preventing access; they mainly show missing/empty DOM snapshots in later states. From an average user perspective, the outcome is that they still don’t have the responsibilities and preferred qualifications they asked for.

Constraints compliance: The agent appears to have respected constraints (no sign-in, no apply, no form submission) and stopped without initiating an application. That is good, but it doesn’t compensate for the missing required extracted content.

Overall, because the agent failed to report two responsibilities and two preferred qualifications, the primary intent was not achieved.
